parsed.why: Constitutional equality, 2024 hate-crime statute covering gender identity, equality court, and a binding 2025 ruling securing trans inmates' care and clothing. Offset by documented township violence, document-mismatch humiliation and unresolved facility access.

No criminalisation and mildly positive public opinion, but a May 2026 police raid detaining ~30 people with extortion and fabricated charges, post-election persecution of LGBTQ people, no hate-crime law, no gender-recognition route or anti-discrimination protection.

Declaration-based gender recognition, discrimination and hate-crime aggravation covering gender identity, marriage and adoption equality, case-by-case prison placement with chosen-form-of-address honoured, no codified birth-sex rule. No documented visitor-facing restrictions; gaps are non-binary marker and absent expression protection.

No criminalisation and courts granting trans relief (2024 HRT ruling, 2025 non-binary discrimination win), but gender identity excluded from hate-crime law after constitutional strike-down, state anti-LGBT rhetoric, residual local exclusion acts, and a trans woman held in a male detention centre with HRT cut off.

Legal gender change forbidden, no non-discrimination claim, and a 2025 UN submission documenting police harassment and arbitrary vagrancy arrests at identity checks — the exact encounter that outs a traveller — plus violent detentions and no documented remedy or support infrastructure.
